description: Get aggregate ~alter network figures. Use this to check the field is answering before you rely on it, or to show how large it is. Returns total identities, verified profiles, query volume and active agent count, as whole-network totals only; nothing here is attributable to any member, and no handle can be identified from it. Takes no parameters. Free L0, no authentication required.
name: get_network_stats
title: Network Statistics
